nodes.author: LauraMiers
nodes.text: I made this thread when the first Covid coinfections showed up. It started with RSV + Covid, & then all these strange viruses like Parechovirus & Bocavirus etc began infecting kids too, & then in 2022 the Covid + strep coinfections kicked off (& lots of bacterial meningitis). And new pathogens are added to the Covid coinfection stew, year after year.

nodes.author: LauraMiers
nodes.text: I can relate so much. I was in good health & very active in my 30s in 2019. Now I see 10 different specialists for a laundry list of diagnoses I didn’t have before Covid. All the doctors I see refuse to connect my new conditions with my previous Covid infections. The only thing that has benefitted me is time, & trial & error. I almost died multiple times, I had near death experiences & literally traveled to the other side. Then I spent 5 years being gaslit by medicine, government, & society, which continues to this day. I accidentally stumbled across a good GI doctor and it made all the difference in the world—but it took 5 years.
